correction_from_previous_metric.corrected_metric: full first-hop action closure blocker count
correction_from_previous_metric.flattening_bug_found: The recursive child-group structure of the compiler report's operations was previously flattened to about two nesting levels. The structure is recursive and heterogeneous: an operation's 'children' is a list of GROUPS (field_path/group_id/operations), and each nested operation can itself carry further groups. The prior helper treated children as a flat operation list and stopped early.
correction_from_previous_metric.second_stream_found: WaitAnimState and other uncompilable operations are NOT present as compiled operations in the report. They are rejected out and survive only in the record/entrypoint 'execution_blockers' list with reason BEHAVIOR_AFFECTING_NODE_NOT_COMPILED. The full action closure must union both streams.
correction_from_previous_metric.consequence: Settlement-body-only metrics understated the closure. 241 settlement bodies were reproduced, but the recursive traversal additionally exposes settlement operations inside conditional/template child groups that were previously invisible.
